title: New span keyword arguments must be threaded through every trace entry point
answers: how do I add a new keyword argument to @mlflow.trace
where must a new start_span parameter be passed through
why does my new trace option not apply to async or generator functions
add a parameter to mlflow.start_span and the decorator
body:
Invariant: a span-level keyword (e.g. `description`, `log_level`, `links`) must be added in every place that builds a span: the `trace` overloads and implementation, `_wrap_function` (sync/async), `_wrap_generator` (its nested `_start_stream_span`), `start_span`, and `start_span_no_context`.
Enforcement: mlflow/tracing/fluent.py:trace, mlflow/tracing/fluent.py:_wrap_function, mlflow/tracing/fluent.py:_wrap_generator, mlflow/tracing/fluent.py:start_span, mlflow/tracing/fluent.py:start_span_no_context.
What breaks if skipped: the option works on plain functions but is silently ignored for async coroutines or generators, because those paths call `start_span`/`start_span_no_context` separately and never see the argument.
Pattern in this PR: `description` was added to the two `trace` overloads, the implementation, both `_wrap_function`/`_wrap_generator` call sites, and both span constructors, mirroring `log_level` and `links`.
applies: Any new kwarg on @mlflow.trace, start_span or start_span_no_context; not for attributes set only after span creation.
says: Trace viewer fails to display custom descriptions on asynchronous functions and streaming generators
Span options like description or log level are ignored for background coroutines
Trace details screen drops configured metadata when viewing streaming or asynchronous runs
Support span description and log level configuration across asynchronous tasks and streams
search: Span-level keyword arguments must be added across all span construction entry points, including the trace overloads and implementation, _wrap_function, _wrap_generator, start_span, and start_span_no_context in mlflow/tracing/fluent.py. Skipping any entry point causes options such as description, log_level, or links to be silently ignored for async coroutines or generators. This rule applies when adding any new keyword argument to @mlflow.trace, start_span, or start_span_no_context, but not to attributes set only after span creation.
